h1: Fahluang Residence Phichit — spacious, quiet rooms near Bung Si Fai for a few hundred baht
intro: If you want a Phichit stay with roomy quarters, a quiet setting, easy parking and Bung Si Fai lake just down the road — Fahluang Residence is the name guests praise most often in town. It's a 3-star hotel in the Tha Luang area, about 1 km from Bung Si Fai. The rooms are bright with private balconies, the rainfall showers run strong and hot, breakfast is included, and rates from about ฿580/night have pushed its review score to 8.6.

body.html: What wins guests over at Fahluang Residence is rooms that feel bigger than the price. Standard rooms like the Classic Deluxe and Classic Standard run around 24 sqm, while the Classic VIP stretches to 48 sqm — larger than many in-town Phichit hotels at the same rate. The rooms are bright with good natural light, and many have a private balcony to sit out and catch the breeze. Plenty of guests say it feels more airy and open than they expected for a hotel in the few-hundred-baht range.

It sits in the Tha Luang area of Mueang Phichit — about 1 km from Bung Si Fai lake, under a 5-minute drive to the Princess Mother Garden Park and the fish-viewing spot. The town and its restaurants are not far, and in the evening there are eateries and bars with live music nearby you can walk to. The caveat to know: it isn't right in the city centre by the market, so without your own car you may lean on Grab a bit — which is why some reviews score location lower than the other categories.

What reviews praise again and again is the cleanliness and the staff. Rooms are clean, beds comfortable, and the rainfall showers run strong and hot. Wi-Fi is strong and smooth, the air-con is cold, and staff are friendly and genuinely helpful — many call the service warmer than the price suggests. The car park is large and handles plenty of vehicles, ideal for self-drivers who don't want to worry about parking.
"The room was bigger than I expected, clean and very quiet, with strong hot water. Lovely staff, easy parking, and it's near Bung Si Fai too — genuinely good value for five or six hundred baht."

Breakfast is a buffet included in the rate, served roughly 6:30–9:30 AM. It's fine by in-town hotel standards, but honestly the selection is fairly limited and not very varied — most guests say it fills you up but isn't the highlight here. One small thing a few people mention: some rooms have no in-room tea/coffee set, so if you need a morning coffee, bring your own or head down to the dining room.

Let's be straight: the building has seen some use. Despite renovations, a few spots still show wear and some fixtures look their age — this isn't a brand-new, sharply modern hotel. And there's no swimming pool here, plus pets aren't allowed, so if you're after a stay with a pool to splash in, look elsewhere. But overall, for travellers who prioritise spacious, clean, quiet rooms and parking, these are trade-offs most are happy to make.

Overall Fahluang Residence scores 8.6 out of 10 on Trip.com and ranks near the top of Phichit's specialty lodgings on TripAdvisor. Rates start around ฿580 and climb by season and room type into the low thousands for a VIP room. It isn't a luxury hotel, but measured on spacious rooms, quiet, cleanliness, parking and a location near Bung Si Fai, it does the job of a relaxed or business base in Phichit nicely on a comfortable budget.

honestSummary: Fahluang Residence is a sensible pick for travellers who value spacious rooms, quiet and parking over a city-centre address — bright rooms with balconies, clean, good hot water, lovely staff, and close to Bung Si Fai, all for a few hundred baht. The trade-offs are a location that wants a car and no swimming pool.
honestChecks: If you don't have your own car — the Tha Luang area isn't by the market or city centre, so you'll rely on Grab to get out for food or sightseeing → if you want to walk everywhere, consider a city-centre Phichit hotel instead.
If you want a hotel with a pool to swim in — there's no pool here → for a relaxed stay with a pool, look at a suburban resort like Lanna Bali Kumnuntuo instead.
If you need in-room coffee/tea in the morning — some rooms have no tea/coffee set → bring your own sachets, or head to the dining room at breakfast.

tips.body: It's only about 1 km away, under a 5-minute drive — go early to walk the park, watch the fish and feed the birds before breakfast.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Fahluang Residence Phichit

faq.q: Where is Fahluang Residence in Phichit, and is it near Bung Si Fai?
faq.a: Fahluang Residence is at 93 Moo 8, Tha Luang, Mueang Phichit. It's about 1 km from Bung Si Fai lake — under a 5-minute drive to the Princess Mother Garden Park and the fish-viewing spot. The town and restaurants are roughly a 5-minute drive away.

faq.q: How much does Fahluang Residence cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from about ฿580/night for a Classic Standard room (breakfast included). Options run from Standard and Deluxe to Fahmaii Deluxe and up to the Classic VIP, which is a roomy 48 sqm at around the low thousands. Prices shift by season and room type, so compare a few platforms before booking.
Yes — free parking with a large car park that holds plenty of vehicles, a point real reviews praise often. The quiet Tha Luang setting suits self-drivers who want to get around Phichit easily.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Fahluang Residence?
faq.a: Rooms are spacious and bright with good natural light, and many have a private balcony. Standard rooms are about 24 sqm while the VIP reaches 48 sqm. Rainfall showers run strong and hot, the air-con is cold and Wi-Fi is strong. The building has seen some use, but it's clean and well kept according to reviews.

faq.q: Does Fahluang Residence have a pool or breakfast?
faq.a: There's no swimming pool, and pets aren't allowed. Breakfast is a buffet included in the rate, served around 6:30–9:30 AM — fine but with a fairly limited selection. If you want a hotel with a pool, consider a suburban Phichit resort instead.

faq.q: Who is Fahluang Residence best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for self-drivers and anyone who values spacious, quiet rooms and parking. It's near Bung Si Fai, peaceful, with warm service. It isn't about luxury or resort facilities, but it's great value in the few-hundred-to-low-thousand baht range.
